message.content: {"edits":[{"op":"change_type","component":"M8","type":"NMOS","pins":{"Drain":"VDD","Gate":"net1","Source":"net11","Body":"GND"},"why":"Schematic M22 is an NMOS follower: drain at VDD, source at vout, body tied to VSS"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M9","pin":"Body","net":"VDD","why":"Body arrow is labelled VDD"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M16","pin":"Body","net":"VDD","why":"Body arrow is labelled VDD"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M12","pin":"Body","net":"GND","why":"Body arrow is labelled VSS"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M19","pin":"Drain","net":"net20","why":"Schematic M3 drain goes to the input-pair tail node"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M17","pin":"Drain","net":"new1","why":"Schematic M13 drain connects to the bottom of R1, not to the M13 source net"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"R3","pin":"Neg","net":"new1","why":"R1 bottom connects to the M13 drain, separate from the M14/M16 gate net"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M22","pin":"Drain","net":"net22","why":"Schematic M14 is diode-connected: drain joins its gate and the M13 source net"}]}

Looking at the netlist, the component IDs clearly don't line up with the schematic labels, so the pipeline's names can't be trusted. I'll work from positions instead, starting with M1, a PMOS at [729,63,778,123] that corresponds to schematic M17, and tracing its drain and gate connections.

I'm checking each component's position against its schematic counterpart, and so far M2, M4, M5 and the resistor R1 line up with their net connections. The M6/M7 pair also looks consistent, since their shared gate net matches the schematic.

I'm comparing the remaining components to their schematic counterparts: the M11 and R2 connections, and the capacitor Cc tied from net7 to ground. Then I'm working through M12, whose drain I'm tracing up through the hop at x=865 to VDD.

I'm checking the gate and source connections for M19 and M20, and tracing the M22 gate back to the node between M17 and M18 through the hop at J1, though I'm not yet sure whether M18's source sits at the top.

I'm tracing the M18 source and drain connections, which seem to run to the M22 gate and source nodes, and I'm checking whether the hop at y=335-350 crosses the M19 line. I still need to confirm whether M22 is actually an NMOS, since the body and source labeling in the drawing isn't clear yet.

I'm settling the M22 device type: it's an NMOS, with its drain at the top tied to VDD and its source at the bottom feeding vout. Its body should go to VSS rather than net12, and the gate stays on net1. Next I'll look at M9 at [729,238], which corresponds to schematic M18.

I'm tracing where M18's drain actually goes, since the line from its bottom terminal runs right toward x≈865 and I can't yet tell whether it turns up to VDD or down to VSS.

I'm checking the M21 connections: its source sits at the top on vout, its drain at the bottom runs down to VSS, and its gate comes off the node shared by M19's source and M20's drain. Tracing M18's drain down to VSS, I'm treating it as ground, which matches the pipeline.

I'm settling the body connections now: M9's body looks like it should go to VDD, and I'm still weighing whether the body pins on M12 and M16 point to VSS or VDD.

I'm wondering whether the GND rail and the VSS rail are actually the same node: the M14 and M15 sources sit on the VSS line at y=501, and the M20 sources sit on the bottom rail at y=675, so merging the two nets would be the natural move if they're one rail.

Now I'm checking the pipeline's M14 and M15 source nets against the schematic, and I think net20 is actually the tail node shared with M3's drain, not the VSS rail.

I'm checking the M3 drain, which in the schematic should sit at the top and tie into the tail node rather than where the pipeline currently puts it.

Now I'm checking M4's drain and gate against the IBIAS node, and I'm treating its source as ground. Then I'm working through M13, whose drain, gate and source I'm still tracing against the schematic.

I'm checking the M16 drain and gate against the schematic, and confirming R3 runs between net15 and net22 before looking at where M13's gate actually lands.

I'm checking M13 against the schematic: its gate looks tied to net15, the same node as M15's gate, and I'm still working out where its drain and source should land relative to R1 and M14.

I'm checking the M13 connections: its source appears to tie to the M14 drain, gate and M16 gate, while its drain sits at the R1 bottom. The pipeline currently gives both drain and source the same net, which would short them, so I'm weighing whether R1's negative terminal needs its own separate net.

I'm concluding that R3's negative terminal and M17's drain can't share net22, since net22 is the node feeding the M14, M16 and M20 gates and M13's source. So R1's bottom should get its own net, with M17's drain on that same net.

I'm checking the M20 drain and gate against the schematic, with its gate on net22 to match the M14 and M16 gates.

I'm checking the M9 drain against the figure: it runs horizontally toward x≈867 and then turns down through a hop, so I'm still working out whether it terminates at VSS or at vout.

Now I'm checking the M22 device: its drain goes to VDD and its source feeds net11, so it should be an NMOS with those pins. The M21 PMOS already has its source on net11 at vout, which fits. For the tail, M19's drain should move to net20, with M14 and M15 sharing that tail node.

Checking the remaining nets now: M5's drain feeds the M6 gate and R1's top, and M5's gate ties to R1's bottom and M10's gate. I'm moving on to M9, whose source sits on VDD, and confirming its gate is on net2.

Checking the remaining pins against the schematic: M10 drains to net9 and takes its gate from net14, with its source on net8, and M8 takes its gate from M7's drain. I'm sorting out how R2's positive side and the R1 top connection line up with M7 before moving on to M11.

I'm checking the M5 drain, which should tie to the M10 drain node and the M18 and M19 gates, and I'm going through the remaining M9, M12 and M13 gate connections against the schematic.

Now I'm setting the body connections: M9 and M16 go to VDD, M12 and M8 go to ground. I'm also changing M8 to an NMOS with its drain on VDD and its gate on net1.

I'm making a few body and drain corrections: M9 and M16 get their bodies tied to VDD, M12 to ground, and M19's drain moves to the shared tail node net20. I'm also splitting off a new net for M17's drain and R3's negative terminal, and setting M22's drain to net22.
